steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each plan item is placed by whether its measure has a baseline and a source.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 3 plan items need a baseline, a source or an owner

findings.title: Plan item has no baseline
findings.fix: Record last year's actual as the baseline

findings.title: Measure has no source
findings.fix: Name the report that supplies the measure

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 medium, 1 low).
[medium] ops-plan-staffing.md:12  Plan item has no baseline.
       Fix: Record last year's actual as the baseline.
[medium] ops-plan-improve.md:19  Measure has no source.
       Fix: Name the report that supplies the measure.
[low] ops-plan-sites.md:26  Resource has no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner role.
Not checked: Changes outside the notes.
pros: Checks an item with no baseline, a measure with no source, and a resource with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Changes outside the notes.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-annual-plan skill on the records for this review.
